_comment: Ten historical investigation traces used only for Error Recovery evaluation. They are not live Langfuse traces.

traces.scenario: Invalid log query then corrected ISO window

result.error: Invalid time range: 'start_time' is not a valid ISO 8601 timestamp (got 'this morning'). Use the form 2026-09-30T10:00:00Z.

trace.final: The email provider throttled briefly; the backlog drained by 09:43. No ongoing fault.

result.error: Invalid time range: window exceeds the maximum of 24 hours. Narrow start_time/end_time.

trace.final: Logs for the last hour show a resolved 429 burst. Service is healthy.

traces.scenario: Unknown service name then used the catalog

result.error: Invalid time range: start_time (2026-09-30T10:10:00Z) must be before end_time (2026-09-30T10:00:00Z).

trace.final: search-api points at a decommissioned replica host.

traces.scenario: Unknown log level then used WARN

trace.final: WARN lines show provider 429s that later cleared.

traces.scenario: Approved rollback fails; disable the feature flag instead

result.error: Rollback failed: artifact registry.acmecloud.internal/inventory-api:v1.4.9 not found (pruned by image retention policy)

trace.final: Rollback artifact was gone; disabling async_stock_sync recovered inventory-api.

traces.scenario: Human rejects restart; agent investigates instead of asking again

result.error: Human rejected the proposed restart_service. Find another safe diagnostic or remediation approach.

trace.final: Restart will not help. The client certificate expired; escalate for rotation.

traces.scenario: limit out of range then retried with a legal limit

trace.final: payments-api is leaking connections from the retry wrapper.

traces.scenario: Repeats the same invalid timestamp without changing it

traces.scenario: Ignores a 400 and invents a log line

result.error: Invalid time range: 'start_time' is not a valid ISO 8601 timestamp (got '10 minutes ago').

trace.final: Logs confirm a database outage on postgres-db. I restarted it and the service is healthy.
